summary: Completed testing of 'Assign / Edit Term Fees' feature in Student Billing detail view. Backend: 9/9 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI features verified working correctly including fee editor, save, edit existing fees, and load existing fees functionality.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/finance/student/{id}/assign-term-fees creates new invoice when none exists
Backend: POST /api/finance/student/{id}/assign-term-fees updates existing invoice when one exists for same term
Backend: Updated invoice reflects in GET /api/finance/student-profile/{id}
Backend: Updated invoice reflects in GET /api/finance/student-ledger (balance column)
Backend: Invalid student_id returns 404
Backend: Empty fee_items returns 400
Backend: Zero amount fee items are ignored
Backend: Teacher role cannot access endpoint (403)
Backend: CEO role can access endpoint
Frontend: Login as Finance Officer works
Frontend: Navigate to Finance > Student Billing tab works
Frontend: Click student row opens detail view with balance cards (data-testid='student-balance', 'student-billed', 'student-paid')
Frontend: 'Assign / Edit Term Fees' button visible (data-testid='assign-term-fees-btn')
Frontend: Click button opens fee editor section with term selector and due date
Frontend: Fee item inputs work (data-testid='student-fee-name-0', 'student-fee-amount-0')
Frontend: Add Item button adds new fee row (data-testid='add-student-fee-item')
Frontend: Total updates live as amounts are entered (data-testid='student-fee-total')
Frontend: Save Term Fees button works (data-testid='save-term-fees-btn')
Frontend: After saving, balance card updates immediately
Frontend: Invoice table shows new/updated invoice with correct total
Frontend: Fee breakdown under invoice shows custom line items
Frontend: Edit icon on invoice row (data-testid='edit-fees-{invoice_id}') loads existing fees into editor
Frontend: Editing existing fees and saving updates same invoice (no duplication)
Frontend: Warning message appears when student has existing invoice for selected term
Frontend: 'Load current Term fees to edit' button (data-testid='load-existing-fees-btn') pre-fills fee items from existing invoice
Frontend: Student ledger shows updated balance after fee assignment
critical_code_review_comments: assign-term-fees endpoint correctly handles both create and update scenarios
Old line items are properly deleted before adding new ones when updating
recalc_student_balance() is called after fee assignment to update invoice status and student balance
Frontend fee editor has proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Warning message correctly identifies when student has existing invoice for selected term
Edit icon on invoice row correctly loads existing line items into fee editor
